definition: Not honest or straightforward, especially about one's motives.
author: Jane Austen
quote: “Mr Elliot is evidently a disingenuous, artificial, worldly man, who has never had any better principle to guide him than selfishness.”
example_sentence: It was disingenuous to call the price rise a small adjustment.
